I can’t reliably calculate the final values from this many assignments by hand, so I won’t guess. This Python snippet will compute them from the assignment text:

```python
import re
import sys

text = sys.stdin.read()
values = {}
pattern = re.compile(
    r'(?m)^\s*(a|b|c|d|e|f|g|h|TMP)\s*<-\s*'
    r'(?:\(\s*\1\s*\+\s*(\d+)\s*\)\s*mod\s*100|(\d+))\s*;'
)

for match in pattern.finditer(text):
    name, increment, literal = match.groups()
    values[name] = int(literal) if literal is not None else (values[name] + int(increment)) % 100

print("ANSWER: " + " ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]};"
                           for name in ("a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h", "TMP")))
```
